key_idea: Factor the values of the polynomial in the number field generated by its root to create paired boxes of algebraic integers, enabling tighter bounds via a bihomogeneous determinant method.
reason: The proof introduces a striking cross-field idea by using number-field factorizations to set up a bihomogeneous determinant method. However, this elegant core is heavily buried under massive technical bookkeeping, geometric case-splits, and computational parameter certificates.
